LOCAL GOVERNMENT ROUNDUP

Meeting activity was light this week, with the Village of Kronenwetter's Utility Committee the only body on the calendar. A busy stretch of meetings across the region begins next Tuesday.

  • The Kronenwetter Utility Committee is set to consider renewing an AT&T water tower lease, reviewing septic tank policy, and taking up a new data center ordinance.

Coming up: Tuesday, Sept. 8 is the week's heaviest day, with the Wausau Common Council, Finance Committee, and Board of Public Works all meeting, alongside the Weston Village Board and several committee sessions. Marathon County's Infrastructure Committee follows Thursday, Sept. 10 at 5 p.m.
